store_data.about_the_game:
YOUR LOOT IS YOUR DECK

Lootdeck is a tactical roguelite deckbuilder where the items you equip dictate the cards in your hand. Survive a dark fantasy dungeon through careful inventory management and grid-based combat.

TACTICAL TTRPG COMBAT

Positioning is everything. Master the synergy between your movement and card effects within a tactical, TTRPG-like combat system where every action relies on individual dice rolls.

EQUIP YOUR ACTIONS

Every weapon, armor, and artifact you find directly adds specific cards to your deck. Change your gear to completely shift your playstyle.

EXPLORE A MEGA DUNGEON, SLAY THE DARK

Dive into a relentless dark fantasy dungeon that changes with every run to destroy the source of an ancient corruption. Face dangerous enemies, uncover mysterious rooms, trade with opportunistic merchants, and scavenge for the loot that will define your build.

store_data.about_the_game:
Illegal Mechanic Simulator is a co-op simulator full of chaos and laughter, where you run a rundown repair shop with up to 4 friends. Try to fix ordinary cars that come to the shop during the day; and head out at night to steal parts from the same model vehicles in the neighborhood to replace what's missing!

Day Shift: "Boss, Doesn't This Have the Part?

During the day, you are honest mechanics. A customer knocks on the door, leaves their rundown car (say, a venerable Clio), and wants it fixed. The problem is: you don't have the spare part for that car, you can't afford to buy brand new parts, and your profit margin is razor-thin. No turning customers away! Raise the vehicle on the lift, diagnose the issue, and prepare the missing parts list. The night shift awaits you...

Night Shift: Greetings to the Cars on the Street!

When darkness falls, grab your toolbox and jack, and hit the streets. Your target is clear: find the exact same car model parked on the street as the one sitting in your shop during the day! Creep up quietly next to the target vehicle you’ve eyed. Divide the roles; one of you keeps watch, another pops the hood, and you unscrew that missing radiator, headlight, or alternator and toss it into your bag. Get back to the shop without setting off the alarm!

,

Fudge it, Fit it, Paint it, and Deliver!

Mount that "second-hand" part you stole onto the customer's car in the shop. If necessary, match its paint, clean it up, and make it look original. When the customer comes to pick up their car, deliver it gleaming like new and pocket the cash. The customer's problem is solved, and your pockets are full! Well, excluding the poor neighbor who finds their car missing wheels or headlights on the street...

Key Features:

4-Player Auto-Shop Coalition: Assemble a full crew of grease monkeys with your friends! Share the roles: while one lifts the car, another keeps watch on the streets at night or removes rims with the jack.

"Exact Match" Part Hunt: Whatever car model is in your shop during the day, you must search for its exact twin on the streets at night. You can't strip parts from just any car!

Realistic and Fast Dismantling: You need to quickly unscrew the right parts (battery, spark plug, headlight, bumper, wheel) and throw them into your bag in a limited time before getting caught. Time is ticking!

Shop Upgrades: Use the money you earn to buy faster dismantling tools, better jacks, or equipment to distract the police.

Neighborhood Suspicion Level: If you steal too many parts from the same neighborhood, residents will catch on and police patrols will increase. Be careful not to become the prey while hunting!

[/]

Are you ready to be a master mechanic by day and a thief by night? Gather your friends, prep the jacks, and scatter quietly into the neighborhood!

store_data.about_the_game:
Necromancer's Ruins is a 2D roguelike platformer where you explore magical ruins, fight monsters, collect treasure, and slowly become stronger between runs.

You play as a young treasure hunter who sets out to find ancient relics hidden inside dangerous ruins. Each expedition takes you through rooms full of enemies, traps, rewards, upgrades, and powerful creatures waiting at the end.

You probably will not survive every run, but that is part of the journey. Return to the lobby, spend what you earned, unlock new upgrades, and try to go further next time.

The game is built around fast platforming, simple but satisfying combat, permanent progression, and a colorful hand-painted fantasy style.

store_data.about_the_game:
This tomb-raiding game is set against the backdrop of warlord infighting in the early 20th century. The protagonist Zhiyao follows her master Chen Jiuyuan to venture into the ominous River Gorge to rob an ancient tomb. Players take on the role of a tomb raider and can choose from four sect branches. You will gather intelligence to pinpoint ancient tomb locations, dig stolen tunnels while evading traps and mechanisms, fend off jiangshi and supernatural creatures, and retrieve treasures before escaping safely. Listen for the whirring of shifting contraptions, hunt for priceless relics, and uncover long-buried secrets. Manage your supplies—food, tools, and special items—as you navigate the perilous underground labyrinths, chasing the truth between life and death.

Four Sect Branches

Treasure Seeker

Inherits powerful ancestral tools and feng shui yin-yang manuscripts to pinpoint burial chambers and underground dungeons.

Warden Exorcist

Carries ample provisions and wields sealing arts to immobilize jiangshi.

Loot Reaver

Fearless in the face of ferocious jiangshi and monsters, excelling at swiftly slaying supernatural foes.

Trap Sage

Master of ingenious mechanical gadgets, able to neutralize all tomb contraptions and barriers encountered underground.

Open World for Free Exploration & Tomb Looting

Thunderpeak Mountains (Rainforest)

New Pagoda Locust Village (Wasteland)

Blackwind Peaks (Volcanic Zone)

South Shore Archipelago (Islands)

Ominous River Gorge (Canyon)

Hundred-Grave Trail (Ghost Town)

Core Gameplay

Purchase tomb-raiding gear: shovels, weapons, rations

Buy intelligence intel to locate hidden tombs

Dig covert access tunnels

Dodge deadly mechanical traps

Combat jiangshi and underground monsters

Loot treasures and escape unharmed

store_data.about_the_game:
PIO: A Robot's Story is an action-adventure with Souls-lite combat. Embark on an unforgettable journey from the retrofuturistic streets of Moscow to the distant Kuril Islands, where every battle, every discovery, and every step brings you closer to a truth that could change everything.

Young inventor Kir and his loyal robot companion, PIO, set out to rescue Kir's kidnapped father. But what begins as a desperate rescue mission soon reveals a vast conspiracy. A carefully orchestrated act of sabotage has corrupted robots that were created to help humanity, turning them into weapons capable of threatening the future of an entire nation.

Join Kir and his loyal robot companion PIO on the adventure of a lifetime. Combine their unique abilities to explore the retrofuturistic world, overcome obstacles, discover hidden paths, and adapt to every challenge you encounter.

Explore diverse environments, uncover hidden secrets, and experience a heartfelt story of loyalty, sacrifice, and hope. Every discovery uncovers another piece of the mystery, while every challenge brings you closer to the truth.

The fate of those you care about is in your hands. Will you uncover the truth before it's too late?

store_data.about_the_game:
Neko Rogue is a roguelike deckbuilder where every fight is decided by your hand, and every wrong play could end in disaster!

This isn’t a simple reskin of “play cards, see a damage number, end turn.” In Neko Rogue, the enemy plays by the same rules as you do: CARDS.

EVERY ENEMY HAS A DECK

• Each foe brings a unique card set—no generic attack-block cookie-cutter packs.

• Multi-enemy street fights and bosses each telegraph threat through real card play.

• Rare finishers and specialized skills make every encounter feel like a different.

INTENT CARDS, NOT JUST INTENT ICONS

• Each round, enemies reveal an Intent Card on the field—not just a symbol.

• You’ll read the board like a real duel: what’s coming, what’s blocked, what’s about to hurt.

• Fight packs and bosses with style—and plan around plays you can actually see.

PLAY THE ENEMY’S TURN BEFORE IT HAPPENS

• Build a deck that hits hard—but also includes skills that target enemy Intent Cards.

• Steal block points, reduce incoming damage, or negate an intent completely.

• Outplay the board, not just the HP bar.

LOOT THE ENEMY’S DECK

• After victory, choose cards and skills from the enemy’s deck to add to your own.

• Turn a street punk’s tricks—or a boss’s signature moves—into weapons for the next fight.

• Grow stronger by absorbing the city’s underworld, one conquered deck at a time.

A CITY THAT SOUNDS ALIVE

• Adaptive music shifts with zones, standard fights, and boss battles.

• Each map district and encounter type has its own sonic identity to pull you deeper into the run.

One more hand. One more intent stolen. One more enemy card claimed.

Build your deck. Break theirs. Take what’s yours.

store_data.about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in the winter holidays and waifu aesthetics with Christmas Waifu, a cozy puzzle game dedicated to charming anime girls and the magical atmosphere of Christmas. Snowy landscapes, festive decorations, gifts, and the warmth of the winter holidays await you.

Game Features

  • 30 Christmas Puzzles

    Each level unlocks a new illustration featuring charming waifus in festive attire. Snow-covered streets, decorated Christmas trees, Christmas presents, and cozy winter interiors create a special festive atmosphere. The difficulty gradually increases and is suitable for players of all levels.

  • Christmas Waifu Gallery

    All collected images are saved in your personal gallery. Build your own collection of festive waifus and return to your favorite illustrations in high quality.

  • Achievement System

    Earn rewards for your progress, speed, and accuracy in completing puzzles. Unlock achievements and expand your collection with new holiday images.

  • Simple controls and a relaxing gameplay

    Intuitive controls and a relaxed pace make the game a great way to unwind and enjoy the holiday atmosphere.

  • Christmas Waifu Charm

    Each girl creates a special holiday mood with her look, emotions, and style. Warm winter outfits, Christmas decorations, and a festive atmosphere make each illustration bright and memorable.

Who is this game for?

Christmas Waifu is perfect for anyone who loves anime, Christmas atmosphere, and relaxing visual puzzles. Complete puzzles, unlock achievements, and enjoy a collection of charming Christmas waifus.

store_data.about_the_game:
Among Demons is a dark fantasy roguelite auto battler where every victory forces a choice: push deeper, strengthen your team, or escape before you lose everything.

Enter an endless dungeon with only two demons. Defeat enemy teams, recruit survivors, arrange your formation, and combine powerful Demonic Pacts to shape each run. The deeper you descend, the stronger and more unpredictable your enemies become.

Extraction is never guaranteed. Leave at the right moment to keep your Souls, experience, and one captured demon shard. Fall in battle and the entire run is lost.

Build Your Demon Collection

Discover 66 demons across six rarities, from Common to Mythic. Each demon has a distinct combat role, including fighters, assassins, healers, poisoners, snipers, tanks, and chaotic attackers.

Train captured demons, improve their stats, and build permanent teams for future challenges.

Shape Every Run

• Draft your starting demons

• Recruit defeated enemies

• Position front-line and back-line fighters

• Choose stacking Demonic Pacts

• Adapt your team as enemies become stronger

• Extract safely or risk everything for greater rewards

Explore a Persistent World

Travel across a large shared world filled with demon encounters, dangerous terrain, ambushes, Forsaken Shrines, Darkness Portals, and powerful world bosses.

Roads offer safer travel, while distant regions contain stronger enemies and greater rewards. Bind your soul to shrines, leave teams hunting for Souls, and challenge other hunters standing on the same tile.

Permanent Progression

Grow your hunter beyond individual dungeon runs through:

• A permanent demon collection

• Soul-based demon training

• An account-wide skill tree

• Daily quests and rewards

• Passive hunting

• PvP rankings and public hunter profiles

Build your collection. Push deeper. Know when to escape.

Discover 66 demons across six rarities, from Common to Mythic. Each demon has a distinct combat role, including fighters, assassins, healers, poisoners, snipers, tanks, and chaotic attackers.

Train captured demons, improve their stats, and build permanent teams for future challenges.

Shape Every Run

• Draft your starting demons

• Recruit defeated enemies

• Position front-line and back-line fighters

• Choose stacking Demonic Pacts

• Adapt your team as enemies become stronger

• Extract safely or risk everything for greater rewards

Explore a Persistent World

Travel across a large shared world filled with demon encounters, dangerous terrain, ambushes, Forsaken Shrines, Darkness Portals, and powerful world bosses.

Roads offer safer travel, while distant regions contain stronger enemies and greater rewards. Bind your soul to shrines, leave teams hunting for Souls, and challenge other hunters standing on the same tile.

Permanent Progression

Grow your hunter beyond individual dungeon runs through:

• A permanent demon collection

• Soul-based demon training

• An account-wide skill tree

• Daily quests and rewards

• Passive hunting

• PvP rankings and public hunter profiles

Build your collection. Push deeper. Know when to escape.

About the Game

  • “The Clone Cycle” is a third-person sci-fi roguelite shooter. Awaken in a collapsed cloning facility, battle aberrant clone lifeforms, collect weapons, abilities and chip modules to break through blockades and reveal the cruel truth behind endless replication cycles.

  • Every death resets the current cycle. All cultivation vessels refill with new clones, and the deadly trial begins again. Trapped in infinite reincarnations, you must eliminate countless identical clone creatures, collect scattered research logs, and expose the institute’s dark conspiracy of pursuing immortality through human cloning.

Game Features

  • Fast-paced TPS Roguelite Gameplay Every run features fully randomized maps, enemy layouts, weapon perks, and attachments.

  • Pure Clone Mirror Combat Face massive hordes of identical clones in intense gunfights — fight endless copies of yourself.

  • Flexible Build System Collect hundreds of weapon perks and chip modules each run to create unique combat builds.

  • Forgiving Cycle Mechanics Death only resets temporary in-run upgrades. Permanent weapons, outfits, lore files, and lab progress remain unlocked. Grow stronger with every cycle without harsh punishment.

  • Smooth & Responsive Gunplay Experience fluid third-person shooting with dodges, sprints, and chain explosions. Discover the full truth of the cloning program through scattered experimental logs and complete lore archives.

Developer

Developed solo by Funflashstudio. Hope you enjoy the game. Thank you for your support!

About This Game

AGON PROTOCOL is a multiplayer PvP game focused on small-scale 2v2 and 3v3 skirmishes.

Build your own hull, equip it with different weapon systems, and test your design against other players. You can edit your ship between engagements to adapt to enemy builds and counter the strategies they are using.

Capture logistics zones to keep your team’s ships supplied, maintain pressure on the enemy, and ultimately push them out of the sector.

Space games can become complicated, and I understand that complexity is part of the appeal for many players. My goal is to make the experience simpler and more approachable while keeping as much depth as possible within the combat, shipbuilding, and tactical layers.

AGON PROTOCOL is still a work in progress, and its features, balance, and content will continue to evolve throughout development.

store_data.about_the_game:
Void Descent is a survivorlike auto-shooter that offers easy to pick up and put down action-packed sessions with multiple game modes, unlockable ships, and meta-progression to take into the endless Void Descent mode. Explore all the possible builds with over 10 million combinations before you even unlock your first augment!

Unique Mechanics

  • Combat Ranking System: The game tracks your performance in real time. Playing defensively or running away will actively tank your combat rank and score multiplier. You have to stay on the offensive to maximize your score.

  • Time Dilation: Your panic button. If you let go of your controls, time slows down to 10% speed, allowing you to navigate dense enemy groups or pivot your strategy mid-combat.

Augment Lab and Meta Progression

  • The Augment Lab: Spend Nexus Cores and Singularities earned during runs to permanently unlock passive buffs and optimize your ship's output.

  • Nexus Ascension: Bring your lab upgrades into high-stakes Ascension runs. Beating the final boss unlocks 5 escalating levels of difficulty modifiers to push your builds to the limit.

  • Endless Mode: Clearing the Nexus levels unlocks the endless Void Descent to see how long your optimal build can survive.

This is a solo passion project, any and all feedback is welcomed and will be considered, I hope you enjoy!

Icons by Font Awesome , used under CC BY 4.0.

store_data.about_the_game:
Twelve classes. One open world. Endless legends.

SoulForge Legends is a co-op action RPG set on Aerethia, a world torn between two factions: the

Elarian and the Legion. Pick a class, build it however you like, and go make a name for

yourself. Play solo, or bring up friends along for the ride.

The whole game is player-hosted, which is the part I'm proudest of. There's no subscription and

no server cost. When you group up, one player hosts the world directly over Steam and everyone

jumps in. And you never have to worry about your progress: everything you earn is tied to your

account and safely backed up, so your characters won't disappear. Play on your desktop tonight,

log in from your laptop tomorrow, and it's all right where you left it.

Twelve classes, and they actually play differently

The Vanguard holds the line behind a shield. The Chronoweaver messes with time. The Hellborn

throws infernal magic around, the Stormcaller chains lightning between enemies, and there are

eight more besides. Every class has its own skills, its own talent tree to grow into, and its

own look. Find the one that clicks and get good with it.

A world worth getting lost in

Aerethia is one connected map you roam at your own pace. Go quiet and solo, or fill it with your

party and cause some trouble. There are roaming Champions to hunt, world bosses that turn up

daily, hourly events to drop into, materials to gather, and professions to level. Levels don't

lock your friends out either, so a high-level buddy can still play alongside someone who just

started.

Co-op without the headaches

Everyone gets a short 8-character friend ID. Add your friends, make a party of up to five, and

you're all in the same world with one click. The leader hosts, but everyone keeps their own

character and their own progress. Nobody fights over loot, and nobody's stuck waiting for one

specific person to log on before they can play.

You're never really alone out there

Even though you host your own games, there's a whole community running alongside you. A global

chat ties everyone on Aerethia together, so you can talk, ask for a hand, show off, or just

trade insults with a stranger. Meet someone you get along with? Grab their friend ID, add them,

and party up for real. You get a channel for your group, private whispers for one-on-one, and if

you're feeling cocky, you can challenge another player straight to the Coliseum by their ID.

The friends you make here are yours to keep.

Ranked, for when you want it to count

The Crucible is the serious side of PvP: ranked 1v1, 2v2 and 3v3, queued from anywhere in the world, with a rating

that actually moves and seasons that wipe the slate. Same fixed power level, same cosmetic-only rewards. Climb as far as your skill takes you.

The Coliseum: no gear, just skill

Sometimes you just want to fight. The Coliseum throws you into a 40-player free-for-all where

everyone is set to the same power level. No stat advantage, no pay-to-win gear, nobody to blame

but your own reflexes. Win fights, earn badges, and spend them on cosmetics: trails, wings,

titles, and some very petty flags you can plant on the people you knock down. You can run it

offline too.

Plenty to chase

  • Gear up with empowerments across eight slots, from common drops to the rare stuff worth
    hunting for.

  • Grow into a talent tree that genuinely changes how you play, not just a pile of +1% nodes.

  • Gather, craft, and empower your way into a stronger character.

  • Collect cosmetic trails, wings, and titles you earn as you go.

One more thing

I'll be straight with you. SoulForge Legends started as the game my friends and I wanted to play together, and it kept

growing from there. It's built by one person, and everything in this description is in the game today, not promised

for later. I'm not finished with Aerethia either: there's more of this world on the way.

Come play.

store_data.about_the_game:
You've come to your senses in a place that shouldn't exist. You have no face, no past, only two goals: to understand how you got here, and to find a way out.

The stratum is the boundary space between the physical and spiritual worlds. Not life and not death, not a dream and not a reality. Those who are not ready to let go get here. Fields, forests, abandoned villages, viscous swamps — each zone lives by its own rules and keeps its own secrets. There is no map here. There is only a way forward.

Fear in Impersonal doesn't come with a flash and a scream. It accumulates in the silence of an open field, where something hears your every step. In abandoned houses, where the traces of someone else's life end without explanation. In a swamp where it's dark even during the day, and where the owner of these places is in no hurry to show up.

Sweepers patrol the open spaces — blind, but with phenomenal hearing. The Wanders fill the abandoned streets, having lost all humanity. The owner of the swamps does not hunt — he is simply present, and that is enough. In this world, you're just a random guest that Stratum wants to get rid of.

Will you be able to get out of this world — or will Stratum swallow you up completely?

• THE UNIQUE WORLD OF STRATUM — Explore areas from dead fields and forests to abandoned villages and viscous swamps — every turn has its own danger and its own mystery.

• ATMOSPHERIC FEAR — The atmosphere is based on isolation, oppressive ambient and the feeling that you are superfluous here. No cheap tricks.

• PUZZLES WITH ECHOES OF THE PAST are classic horror genre puzzles that gradually reveal the history of the world and who you were before it.

• ENEMIES WITH LOGIC — Sweepers react to sound, Wanders fill the dead streets, the Owner of the Swamp dictates his rules. One approach won't work twice.

• YOUR CHOICES CARRY WEIGHT — Decisions made during the game can have consequences. And not always obvious ones.

store_data.about_the_game:
Move from each room to the next in the paradoxical Hotel Hilbert, with its rooms infinitely many, yet all occupied. Shift Entropy,  meet other Guests, find lost Belongings and advance ever forward in Hotel Hilbert, where the laws of physics are mere suggestions.

Features

  • Solve puzzles by resizing furniture to reach the next room.

  • Clear 64 levels in the main story, plus extra and challenge levels.

  • Piece storylines together through subtext and inference.

  • Find dozens of collectibles that expand on the story and characters. 

  • Move with precision through deep and flexible mechanics that allow for tight platforming.

  • Compete for the fastest times in the built-in speedrun mode.

  • Architect your own levels or play those of other Guests through the custom level workshop.

  • Enjoy fully organic and original visual and sound assets, crafted with no use of AI.


"Let Entropy be that which guides you to the next room, for so it will."

store_data.about_the_game:
Sky Homestead is a cozy farming and automation game set on a chain of floating islands.

Three hundred years ago the Skychain shattered. The bridges fell, the beacons went dark, and the islands drifted apart. Someone has left you a letter, a rickety cottage on the last lit isle, and a very old to-do list.

Farm the floating fields

Till, plant, water, harvest. Fifteen crops, from honest pumpkins to crystalbuds that only grow where the Hum runs strong — the current of crystal energy that once held the Skychain together.

Automate the cozy way

Chop the wood yourself, or build a line that does it while you're somewhere else. Over 35 machines — furnaces, crafters, smelteries, mills — chain into production lines, fed by haulers and powered by the Hum. Start with one furnace. End with an island that runs itself.

A crew with names

Pip the Lumberjack. Tansy the Farmer. Hire helpers who arrive with their own tools, pay them in gold and hot meals, and watch them walk home to their cottages at dusk. They keep working whether you're watching or not.

Rebuild the Skychain

Multiple hand-built islands, each holding ruins that remember what they were. Fund the Restoration Board, watch bridges rebuild themselves plank by plank, and meet the villagers who come home when the lights come back on. Over 100 objectives across roughly 30 hours.

Sail the sky

Chart routes for cargo balloons hauling bulk freight between islands, and send nimble drones point-to-point. A frozen crest, a witchwood, a volcanic forge-isle — each with its own economy to wake up.

Delve when you dare

Beneath the oldest island lies the Deep Barrow: procedurally generated, unlit, and full of things that were left down there for a reason. Bring a sword, bring a lantern, come home with soul crystals. Or don't go at all — the farm doesn't mind.

A note from the one-person crew

Sky Homestead is made by a single developer. Everything you see here — screenshots, trailer, all of it — is the game as it stands today, and it will keep getting better right up to launch and beyond. If these little islands speak to you, a wishlist genuinely moves the needle for a solo project.

store_data.about_the_game:
A basic RPG Slime in exile

You’ve been banished from the Kingdom of Turnabased after yet another defeat in a world where the respawn rate seems to be regulated.

Your new home—a hidden village and its surroundings—is a small open area waiting to be explored.

There are no battle scenes here, but plenty of treasure chests and various secrets await you!

Encounters with unusual monsters!

Other monsters considered useless for battle have been living in the village for a very long time.

Gardeners, builders, engineers, and more—you’ll find all kinds! Go meet them and help them with quests that even a newbie slime can handle, and learn new skills to move around more easily!

You’ll also be able to trade valuable items in a side quest that runs throughout the game. Each monster has its own specific request, and you’ll be able to carry one item at a time and store another in a dedicated chest.

A trial and a destiny in your hands

The reasons that led you into exile are full of twists and turns, and the game features multiple possible endings.

A subtle narrative thread will lead you to a more substantial challenge as your adventure unfolds: the dungeon.

Its trials will put your modest new skills to the test, but don’t panic—this is still a cozy game!

It’s up to you to decide how your quest ends!

store_data.about_the_game:
BACKROOMS PINTEROI is a co-op "horror" game where you and your friends must venture into the Backrooms and somehow find a way out. Sounds easy, right? Trust me... it isn't.

Every level is different. There are puzzles, creatures that want to kill you, endless hallways, and plenty of places you definitely shouldn't walk into. What starts as a peaceful exploration can quickly turn into everyone sprinting for their lives while someone screams into the voice chat... yes, the game has proximity voice chat.

You can play alone (if you're really brave or nobody wants to play with you) or with your friends. You'll need to find keys, collect items, solve puzzles, and figure out how to reach the next level without dying along the way... if you can.

Explore the Backrooms

There are plenty of different levels inspired by the Backrooms. Endless yellow offices, empty hotels, hospitals with endless corridors, tunnels, and all kinds of places that look exactly like something you'd expect to find in the Backrooms (the game's name kind of gives it away).

Every map has its own puzzles, secrets, and at least one unpleasant surprise waiting for you.

Don't Leave Your Friends Behind... (Or Do)

Working together makes things a lot easier. Share items, warn your teammates if you see something weird, and help each other out when someone inevitably messes up... because someone definitely will.

Sometimes you'll have to stick together, and other times you'll need to split up. And yes, there will always be that one friend who says, "I'll just check over here for a second," and then vanishes forever. (I hate that guy too.)

The Entities

The Backrooms are full of some pretty nasty things.

Every entity behaves differently. Some can hear you, some can see you, and others have their own lovely ways of ruining your day.

Solve Puzzles

It's not all about walking... or running.

You'll also need to find keys, flip switches, restore power, move objects, and solve puzzles to keep progressing.

And just when you think you've figured everything out... you'll realize the key has been sitting right in front of you for the last ten minutes.

A "Fun" Horror Experience

The scary part of BACKROOMS PINTEROI isn't just the monsters.

It's never knowing if you're actually alone, hearing strange noises at the end of a hallway, or staring at a corner for ten seconds because you're convinced you saw something move.

And when everything suddenly goes completely silent...

...it's probably because something has already found you.

Features

  • Play solo or with your friends.

  • Lots of different Backrooms-inspired levels.

  • Entities with unique behaviors.

  • Puzzles that will make your friend ask, "Okay... now what?"

  • Keys, tools, and useful items scattered everywhere.

  • Online co-op.

  • Regular updates with new levels, creatures, and more content.

The Backrooms don't seem to have an end.

Maybe the next door is your way out...

...or maybe you'll end up wondering why you didn't just stay home.

The gods have cursed you to repeat your crime forever.
Every attempt to steal the Shard of Heaven ends the same way.
The Void awakens, and the run begins again.

Run, Fight, Escape!

Gain points and unlock new abilities!

Every run generates points you can use to unlock further speed increases or extra abilities allowing you just go faster and further with every run.

Test yourself with the challenge mode!

Challenge mode limits the number of skill points you can spend allowing you to focus on a small, honed build and compare scores on a level playing field.

How long can you outrun the inevitable?

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Ducasse, a management, strategy, and simulation game where you take control of your very own traveling fairground.

Purchase new rides, recruit fairground workers, manage your budget, and set up your fair in towns and villages with limited space. Attract as many visitors as possible, meet their needs, and transform your small local fair into a regional attraction.

Set in a world inspired by traditional fairgrounds, filled with humor, unexpected events, and management challenges, every location presents a new puzzle to solve. Optimize the placement of your rides and caravans, adapt to events throughout the season, and steadily grow your business through a complete skill tree.

Featuring hand-drawn artwork inspired by iconic retro action-game loading screens, Ducasse offers a unique atmosphere combining nostalgia, humor, and strategy.

Manage Your Own Fairground

Start with a few modest attractions and grow your business season after season. Every decision affects your finances, visitor satisfaction, and reputation.

Optimize Every Location

Each fairground site has limited space. Carefully position your rides, stalls, and caravans to make the most of every square meter.

Recruit and Manage Your Staff

Every employee has their own skills. Build an efficient team to improve service quality and keep your fair running smoothly.

Deal with Unexpected Events

Situations can be beneficial, disastrous, or simply absurd. Can you keep your fairground on track?

Unlock New Content

Progress through a skill tree to gain access to new rides, upgrades, and business opportunities.

Travel Across Different Locations

Set up your fairground in various towns and villages, each with unique challenges, visitor numbers, and space limitations.

Key Features

  • Build and manage your own fairground.

  • Purchase and unlock numerous rides and services.

  • Recruit, train, and manage fairground workers.

  • Optimize attraction placement on limited maps.

  • Face humorous and unexpected events.

  • Expand your business through a skill tree.

  • Explore multiple maps with unique challenges.

  • Manage finances, reputation, and visitor satisfaction.

  • Hand-drawn art style inspired by retro illustrations.

store_data.about_the_game:
A meteor shower brought spores from another world. Anyone who breathed the dust stopped being a person: the horde was born. You are one of the few immune, and the only way to end this is to reach the source of the infection... world by world.

Apocalipsis Survivor is an action survivor: you move, and the aiming and shooting happen automatically while you dodge ever denser waves. You level up, choose weapons and upgrades on the spot, and build combos that become unstoppable... or die trying.

  • 10 worlds (30 stages) with their own biomes and music: from the ruined city to the alien dimension.

  • 16 weapons with evolutions (pistol, shotgun, whip, orbs, laser, missiles, molotov, turrets, mines, drones and more).

  • 10 playable characters, each with different stats and a different starting weapon.

  • 10 bosses with telegraphed attacks you have to learn to read.

  • 5 modes: Survival, Endless Horde, Waves, Boss Rush and Rescue.

  • Permanent progression: coins, unlocks, workshop upgrades, achievements and stage stars.

  • A story that unfolds between worlds, with cinematic artwork.

Easy to pick up, hard to put down. How far will you get before they catch you?

THE GAME GROWS EVERY WEEK

🗓 Daily challenge — every player in the world faces the same map with the same character. One score, one global leaderboard, every day.

🌐 Leaderboards in Endless Horde — compete for the best time and the most kills.

🩸 Relics — powerful pacts with a drawback: every run builds differently.

💀 Three difficulties per world — Normal, Hard (+35% coins) and Survivor (+70%).

📊 Damage by weapon at the end of every run, to perfect your build.

🎮 Full interface and text in English and Spanish.

store_data.about_the_game:
Grab a knife. Somewhere in this room, something is secretly cake — and next round, it's your turn to bake the lie.

Hidden in Plain Cake is a first-person multiplayer sculpting game where you carve, build, smooth, and paint real sliceable cake into perfect copies of everyday objects. Every cut goes all the way through — and reveals the sponge layers inside.

🔪 Sculpt Like It's Clay. Slice Like It's Cake

No blocks, no grids — free-form sculpting on a real 3D mesh. Lasso a shape and cut it clean out, shave with plane cuts, or carve to a precise depth.

Build up as freely as you cut down: extrude new volume in any shape, dome it, then smooth everything into one seamless surface.

🎂 It's Cake All the Way Down

Your creation isn't a hollow prop. Slice it open anywhere and the interior shows honest cake — stripes of sponge and filling, exactly where you cut.

Paint the outside to sell the illusion. A shoe, a toolbox, a potted plant... whatever the surface says, the inside tells the truth.

🕵️ Fool Your Friends

Play online with friends through Steam. Walk the room in first person, study everyone's handiwork up close, and decide: real object, or dessert in disguise?

Then swap roles. Your sculpt, their suspicion.

Features

  • Free-form sculpting — lasso cuts, plane cuts, depth-capped carves, volume adding, and surface smoothing

  • True sliceable interiors — every cut exposes real cake layers, not textures on a shell

  • Full paint tools — freehand brush, lines, and shape fills to disguise (or decorate) anything

  • Online multiplayer — host or join lobbies with friends via Steam

  • Undo without fear — experiment wildly, roll back the disasters

Can you spot the cake? Can you be the cake?

store_data.about_the_game:
GeoPinQuest is a 3D-globe geography game. Spin the Earth, pin countries, cities, and flags across 20 mode variants, and watch every miss turn into a lesson - a red dashed arc draws itself between your pick and the answer, so you always see how close you came.

Five game types, 20 modes

  • Country - tap the country that matches the name on the target card.

  • City - rotate and zoom the globe so a red bullseye sits over the target city, then pin it.

  • Flag - the target is a flag emoji, nothing else. Tap the country whose flag it is.

  • Higher / Lower Country - two countries per round; guess whether the second has a higher or lower population than the first. That one becomes the first of the next round, so every guess chains into the next.

  • Higher / Lower City - same population duel, played with cities.

Every game type runs in Classic (10 rounds), Endless (no round cap), Timed (60s / 30s / 10s / 5s per round), and Endless Timed variants - 20 modes in all. Every mode lets you filter the target pool by continent, or by individual country for the City modes, so you can drill any region you want to learn.

Distance-based scoring you can see

Country and Flag rounds score by centroid-to-centroid great-circle distance. Guess Germany when the answer is France (764 km apart) and you still score 925 out of 1,000 - plus a thick red dashed arc drawn on the globe between your pick and the correct country. The result card grades every miss: So close! under 200 km, Not bad. under 1,500 km, Way off. beyond that.

City mode uses the same idea, scaled up: a 10-km bullseye earns the full 10,000 points, and you lose points linearly as your pin drifts. All the math is real great-circle distance on the sphere - no planar approximations even at the poles or the antimeridian.

251 real countries, half a million real places

The globe uses a real GeoJSON country dataset - 251 countries with proper borders, centroids, and continent groupings - and a per-country locality dump for City mode: roughly half a million towns, villages, and hamlets that actually exist on Earth. Everything ships in the game; no external downloads at first launch.

103 achievements and a per-mode scoreboard

Bronze / Silver / Gold / Diamond score tiers for every mode, endless-streak trophies, a Near Misses category that celebrates the "so close" moments, career-total 100,000 and 1,000,000-point milestones, and a lifetime collection challenge that tracks every country you've ever correctly identified across every game you've played (25% / 50% / 75% / 100% of all 251). Runs are ranked per-mode with timestamps in a six-tab scoreboard.

Built for motion

Momentum-based globe controls: drag to yaw and pitch, right-drag to roll, mouse-wheel or pinch to zoom, and a compass button to snap north back to the top.

store_data.about_the_game:
Doll Arena is a dark metroidvania with PvP duels, set in the world of Slavic folklore. You play as a red doll with button eyes — a folk guardian doll armed with nothing more than a handful of needles — and that's all you need to survive.

A world of Slavic belief

In Slavic folklore, a motanka is a guardian doll — bound from scraps of cloth and thread, traditionally faceless, made not by sewing but by winding, and hung over a cradle to ward off evil spirits. Our heroine is a dark mirror of that tradition: she has a face, she has eyes — two red buttons — and instead of waiting for evil to wander off on its own, she goes hunting for it, needle in hand. Doll Arena's dark, painterly visuals draw from the same folklore as tales of Baba Yaga and the spirits of the forest — a world where a protective charm and a real threat are separated by a single thread.

A needle you have to fight for

Forget a sprawling arsenal — you get a handful of needles, carried on you at all times. Up close, you stab and parry with them. At range, you throw them to strike before your enemy reaches you. But every needle you throw disappears from your reserve. Run dry, and you're defenseless until you dash in and reclaim the ones already in the air. It's a combat system built on managing a limited resource in real time — and that's exactly what makes every fight, especially in PvP, so tense.

Precision movement that drives exploration

Movement in Doll Arena isn't a side dish to combat — it's the first line of defense. Jumps, dashes, and wall-bounces let you slip between platforms, dodge danger, and reach places that look unreachable at first glance. Mastering these three tools is the foundation both exploration and combat are built on.

Metroidvania: an interconnected world full of secrets

Doll Arena is a metroidvania in the classic sense — every location connects into a single, cohesive map, and each newly earned ability opens a path you couldn't cross before. Exploration, hidden routes, secret rooms, and the satisfaction of finding a shortcut you never knew existed sit at the core of the game's structure, familiar to fans of the genre.

PvP: face your friends

Beyond the single-player mode, where you take on bosses and obstacles solo, Doll Arena features a PvP mode — a direct clash against another player, built on the same rules of precision movement and needle combat. Invite a friend, face off in the arena, and find out who manages their own arsenal better when every thrown and reclaimed needle is on the line.

Key Features

  • Precision movement — jump, dash, and wall-bounce as the foundation of exploration and combat

  • Needle combat with a limited reserve — stab, parry, throw, then race to reclaim your needles with a dash

  • Classic metroidvania structure — an interconnected world, secrets, and abilities that open new paths

  • PvP mode — face your friends on arenas where every needle counts

  • A heroine born of Slavic folklore — a red motanka doll with button eyes

  • Painterly, atmospheric visuals with a distinctive doll aesthetic

store_data.about_the_game:
Stranded is a 4-12 player horror survival game where you and your friends are survivors stranded on a cursed island. An evil entity known as the "dark stalker" approaches players, offering them life in exchange for killing another survivor.

HOW TO PLAY

The rules of the game are straightforward.

There is 1 engineer, while everyone else is a survivor. The engineer must find and repair the radio tower to signal for help.

Repair parts are scattered across the island and must be handed to the engineer, as they are the only one that can fix the broken tower.

There are 3 ways to win: Find and Repair the Radio Tower, Find and Fire the Flare Gun (instant win), or Escape on an Abandoned Ship with only 2-3 members of your crew.

THE DARK STALKER

The island is haunted by an evil spirit known as the “dark stalker”. The stalker approaches players individually as they explore the island. Players have two choices: Work with the stalker to kill a fellow survivor, or sacrifice themselves instead.

If they choose to work with the stalker, they can continue to help their team once the deal is complete.

SURVIVAL

The game features three survival mechanics: Warmth, Hunger, and Sleep. Players must ensure these stats do not run out at any point in the game, or they die.

To refill warmth, keep the central campfire lit. Warmth goes down as you drift away from the campfire.

To refill hunger, eat berries found in bushes around the island. Just keep in mind that a small percentage of these berries are poisonous and cause instant death.

To refill sleep, press Z at any time. The only catch is that you cannot see anything while you are sleeping.

store_data.about_the_game:
Game Overview

Battle Marine Advance! is a single-screen shooter where you fight using horizontal movement, jumps, rapid-fire shots, and a powerful laser.

Keep landing your shots, build combos without taking damage, and collect medals to increase your score multiplier. Accuracy matters, but so does knowing when to use your laser—which makes you temporarily invincible—or jump to automatically collect items.

Battle Marine Advance! supports Steam Achievements and online leaderboards.

You can also watch replays submitted to the leaderboards.

Controls

This game is optimized for use with a game controller.

Keyboard controls are also supported.

Shots and Score Multiplier

Repeatedly press the Shot button to fire.

Keep hitting enemies to increase your score multiplier, up to a maximum of ×16. Missing a shot or taking damage makes it harder to maintain your multiplier.

Aim carefully and destroy your enemies without wasting a shot.

Laser

Hold the Shot button to charge your laser, then release it once fully charged to fire.

You are invincible while firing the laser, and all medals on the screen are collected automatically.

Use it not only as a powerful attack, but also as a defensive tool for breaking through enemy fire.

Jump

Press the Jump button to jump.

While jumping, you automatically collect all medals on the screen. However, health items are also converted into medals, so choose your timing carefully.

Medals and HIT Combos

Enemies release medals when destroyed.

Collecting medals increases the Medal Rate displayed in the upper-left corner of the screen.

  • Collect a standard medal directly: Medal Rate +2

  • Collect a medal automatically by jumping or using the laser: Medal Rate +1

  • Collect a gold medal: Medal Rate +3

Keep destroying enemies within the time limit without missing a shot or taking damage to build your HIT combo. Once you reach 100 HIT or more, standard medals turn into gold medals and are collected automatically.

Your score is determined by your Medal Rate and Score Multiplier. However, missing a shot or taking damage reduces your Medal Rate by 21.875%.

Maintain your accuracy, avoid enemy fire, and aim for a high score.

Life and Recovery

Battle Marine Advance! uses a life-based health system.

Taking damage reduces the Life gauge in the lower-right corner of the screen. The game ends when the gauge is completely depleted.

When your Life gauge is not full, destroying an enemy causes a health item to appear. Collect it directly to recover Life. If you jump, however, the health item is converted into a medal and collected automatically.

Decide whether recovering Life or earning more points is more important in each situation.

There are no invincibility frames after taking damage. If you touch another enemy projectile during the damage animation, you will lose additional Life. Finding a safe position is especially important during the final stage, where enemy fire becomes particularly dense.

Ranks

When the game ends, you receive a rank based on your performance.

  • E1–E9: Enlisted (Beginner)

  • W1–W5: Warrant Officer (Intermediate)

  • O1–O6: Officer (Advanced)

  • O7–OB: Flag Officer (Expert)

  • Special Rank: Legendary Seaman (Normal/ALL)

  • Special Rank: Poseidon (Master/ALL)

Skill Score

Ranks W1 and above are generally determined by your Skill Score.

Your Skill Score is calculated as follows:

  • 1 point per stage reached (maximum 10 points at All Clear)

  • 1 point per 100 HITs in your highest combo (maximum 20 points at 2,000 HITs)

  • 1 point for every 10 seconds a combo of 100 HITs or more is maintained (maximum 20 points at 200 seconds)

  • 1 point per 25 successful hits (maximum 20 points at 500 hits)

  • −1 point per missed shot (no maximum penalty)

  • 1 point per 30 enemies defeated (maximum 20 points at 600 enemies)

  • 1 point per 100 points in your highest Medal Rate (maximum 20 points at 2,000)

  • 1 point per 300 points in your cumulative Medal Rate (maximum 10 points at 3,000)

  • −1 point per 5 recovery items collected (no maximum penalty)

  • If the calculated score is below 0: 0 points

  • If the calculated score exceeds 120: 120 points

If your Skill Score is below 30, you will instead be awarded a rank from E1 to E9 based on the stage you reached.

How to Achieve a High Rank (Experts Only)

For experienced shooter players, simply clearing the game—unlocking Legendary Seaman and Poseidon—will probably feel relatively easy.

However, the difficulty jumps to an entirely different level when you aim for a high rank.

That is where this game reveals its true form.

You can do it...

Here are some tips for conquering every rank:

  • First, ignore ranks entirely and clear Normal Mode (ALL) to unlock Master Mode.

  • Master Mode is not a “high-difficulty mode”; it is a mode that makes high ranks easier to achieve:

    • No recovery items appear, so you cannot lose rank from recovering Life!

    • Missing a shot also causes damage, so the missed-shot penalty is finite!

    • You have more frames before your combo breaks, making it easier to reach 2,000 HIT (the maximum score)!

  • The laser is powerful, but relying on it too heavily reduces the number of shots fired per unit time, which you need to increase the successful-hit portion of your Skill Score. If you have fired fewer than 500 shots by the time you clear Master ALL, revise your route to be more selective about when you use the laser.

  • The position of the first crab that appears in Stage 6 is determined by the direction pressed on the very first frame immediately after Stage 1 begins. (Left input = appears on the left; right input = appears on the right; no input = randomly appears on the left or right.)

  • A perfect Skill Score of 120 is impossible with even one missed shot, so finish with 0 missed shots if you are aiming for Rank 29 (the highest rank). (Be sure to fire at least 500 shots, however.)

  • Using a rapid-fire controller is not recommended:

    • Missed shots are more likely.

    • You are more likely to get caught in secondary explosions.

    • You do not need to keep 16-shot rapid fire going throughout the run to reach 500 shots by ALL; relaxed bursts (around three shots per attack) are enough.

  • With a perfect score of 120, Rank 29 takes priority over Legendary Seaman (Rank 27) and Poseidon (Rank 28), even if you clear ALL, so it is fine to complete the game.

  • If you are aiming for Fleet Admiral (Rank 26), avoid clearing ALL and achieve a Skill Score of at least 100.

  • E1/E2 are easy to unlock in Master Mode.

  • E3–E9 are easy to target in Normal Mode by intentionally missing shots or collecting recovery items.

Steam Version Features

Battle Marine Advance! is based on the GBA version of Battle Marine included with Battle Marine, with additional features developed specifically for Steam.

  • Steam Achievements

  • Online leaderboards

  • Leaderboard replay playback

  • In-game switching between fullscreen and windowed modes

  • An Exit Game option on the title screen

About the GBA Version

The GBA ROM that can be used with original hardware or emulators remains included with Battle Marine.

Battle Marine Advance! does not include a ROM file for use with external hardware or emulators.

If you require the ROM file, please purchase Battle Marine.

Streaming and Content Usage Policy

You may create and publish videos, livestreams, gameplay commentary, articles, social media posts, fan works, and other content featuring this game without prior permission.

This applies to both commercial and non-commercial use, regardless of whether the content is monetized.

However, individual assets from the game—including images, sound effects, and music—may not be redistributed or reused as standalone content.

  • This application includes mGBA, licensed under the Mozilla Public License 2.0 (MPL 2.0).

  • The corresponding source code covered by MPL 2.0 is available in the “suzukiplan/dewpoint-advance” repository on GitHub.

store_data.about_the_game:
The belt is rich. The belt is hostile. You have six gun arms.

Gunmetal Orbit is a fast 2.5D space-mining arena roguelite. Pick your spacer, launch into the asteroid field, and survive escalating waves while your weapons fire on their own — your job is to fly: kite the swarm, dodge the bolts, crack the rocks, and scoop the ore before something else does.

MINE UNDER FIRE

  • Ore is money, and money is guns. Pop asteroids, haul the chunks home, and sell at the dock — every run funds the next fight.
  • The field fights back: shooters, kamikaze poppers, splitters, armored heavies, ore-stealing salvage scarabs, and gravity-well Magnetars that drag you off your line.
  • Every few waves the belt shifts sectors — amber Scrap Drifts thick with rock, electric Ion Storms that scorch whole zones of the arena.

BUILD ABSURD LOADOUTS

  • Stack up to six auto-firing weapons — six SMGs screaming at once is a legitimate strategy.
  • Level-up picks and the rotating Outfitter shop snowball damage, attack speed, lifesteal, drones, and dashes into a screen full of bullets.
  • Combine duplicate weapons into higher tiers; recycle what doesn't fit the build.

GROW THE OUTPOST

  • Secured waves earn station blueprints — sentry spires, refinery annexes, cargo drone hangars. Your dock becomes a base that fights and earns alongside you.

RUNS SHAPED LIKE YOUR SESSION

  • Pick a mode — Standard, Endless, Mining Rush, or a challenge preset — and a hazard level 0–5: H0 is a quick patrol, H5 is a 30-wave campaign with mid-bosses.
  • Death is real: a hull breach ends the run and archives it to your Service Record.
  • Docking saves. Suspend anytime. Three slots hold three separate runs.

BUILT FOR THE DECK

  • Gamepad-first twin-stick controls with native button prompts; keyboard and mouse fully supported.
  • Native 1280×800, tuned for a locked 60 fps on Steam Deck hardware.
  • A dubstep soundtrack keeps the belt moving.

store_data.about_the_game:
Orbisphere is a cozy idle-arcade game about a small astronaut, named Orbi, with a big job: collect stardust to wake a sleeping station and find your way home.

Ride the orbit - the active loop

Drift through space, using your jetpack to speed up. Orbi can't change directions with his jetpack. Instead, utilise the gravitational pull of planets to change directions and slingshot your way through space. Collect stardust as you go and return to your station to upgrade your equipment. 

Feed the machines - the idle loop

Stardust feeds machine. Machines feed upgrades. Use the lab, 3D printer, solar wings and drone dock. Then let your OrbiBot collect stardust while you're afk. 

Upgrades let Orbi reach further into space in hopes of finding his way home.

Risk & Reward

Stardust is plentiful in the asteroid belt, but so are the hazards. What you gather only counts once you carry it home.

Build your garden oasis

Past the hazardous asteroid belt there is a light that shouldn't be there. Follow it and you might find something worth planting. 

Beware the wormholes!

  • Hands-on arcade sling-shotting with real momentum

  • A deepening idle economy that runs while you're away

  • Machines, gardens and upgrade trees to wake one by one

  • A quiet, lonely corner of space to make your own

  • Mini-games to boost your economy

  • Full controller support

  • No internet required, no accounts, no in-app purchases

store_data.about_the_game:
An atmospheric 2D stealth-action platformer set inside an abandoned gothic castle. You are a lone assassin sent into the ruins to end the reign of the vampire lord who dwells within. Every hall is dark, every guard is a threat, and the shadows are your only ally.

Move like a shadow. Run, leap, and climb through crumbling zones of the castle — from the outer walls to the depths beneath. Read the environment, time your movement, and choose when to slip past danger and when to strike.

Two ways to kill. Close the distance for a fast melee finish, or line up a ranged shot to take enemies down before they ever see you. Chain your movement into your attacks and keep the pressure on.

Solve the castle's mechanisms. Hidden switches, moving platforms, and destructible walls block your path forward. Trip the right mechanism, break through the right wall, and unlock the route deeper into the keep.

Face the Vampire Lord. Reach the heart of the castle and confront a multi-phase boss that grows more dangerous as the fight goes on. Learn its patterns, survive its assault, and end the curse.

Never lose your progress. Checkpoints and an on-screen minimap keep you oriented as you push through each zone, so every death is a lesson — not a setback.

store_data.about_the_game:
Reaching For The Star is a life simulation and role-playing game set in the modern entertainment industry.

You play as a young woman taking her first steps into show business. Beginning as an unknown newcomer, you will plan your daily schedule, improve your abilities, pursue new opportunities, meet people from across the industry, and gradually discover what kind of star—and what kind of person—you want to become.

Study acting, singing, and dancing. Audition for television dramas and films. Record music, appear on variety shows, attend promotional events, or take time away from the spotlight to rest and connect with the people around you.

Every appearance under the spotlight may become a turning point in your career. Every decision behind the scenes may change your relationships and lead your story in a different direction.

Will you become a beloved idol, an acclaimed actress, a versatile all-around entertainer, or choose a life you never expected when your journey began?

Your career is yours to shape.

Plan Each Day of Your Career

Time is one of the most valuable resources in show business.

Plan your schedule week by week and decide how to balance work, training, rest, and your personal life.

Take acting lessons, practice your vocals and dancing, improve your stamina and elegance, or step away from work to recover from mounting stress and exhaustion.

A demanding schedule may help you improve quickly, but pushing yourself too far can affect both your health and your performance. How you spend your limited time will influence your abilities, condition, and future opportunities.

Become the Artist You Want to Be

There is no single path to success.

Throughout your career, you can develop a wide range of attributes, including:

  • Acting, Singing, and Dancing

  • Charisma, Elegance, and Fashion

  • Confidence, Eloquence, and Intelligence

  • Stamina, Creativity, and Talent

  • Fame, Popularity, and Industry Influence

Different jobs and career paths require different strengths.

Devote yourself to acting and become a performer capable of taking on challenging roles. Develop your singing and dancing skills and command the stage as an idol. Strengthen your confidence, humor, and communication skills to show a different side of yourself to the public.

The choices you make will shape a career that is uniquely your own.

Pursue New Opportunities

Begin with small and often overlooked jobs before working your way toward major productions.

Take part in television dramas, films, music projects, commercials, variety shows, and other entertainment activities. Each opportunity has its own genre, cast, requirements, and potential rewards.

Your abilities, reputation, public image, and relationships within the industry may all influence which opportunities become available to you.

Prepare for auditions, compete for the roles you want, and prove yourself through every performance. One successful project may transform you into an overnight sensation, while a disappointing result may still become an important step in your growth.

Meet the People Behind the Spotlight

During your journey, you will meet actors, singers, idols, directors, writers, and many others working throughout the entertainment industry.

Each person has their own personality, history, ambitions, and private struggles. Some may become close friends or professional rivals. Some may offer support when you need it most, while others may gradually become someone special.

Spend time together through work, invitations, and everyday encounters. Your decisions about ambition, friendship, and romance will shape your relationships and open different stories and possibilities.

Face the Pressure of Fame

Popularity brings more than applause.

As your name becomes more widely known, you will face demanding schedules, public expectations, media attention, professional competition, and growing physical and emotional pressure.

Fatigue and stress can affect your performance, while difficult decisions may cause you to miss valuable opportunities. Learning when to push forward and when to slow down is an important part of building a sustainable career.

There is no single definition of success.

You may become a superstar celebrated for countless performances and awards. You may discover the field you truly love and build a future with the people who matter to you. Or you may realize that the life you want is different from the dream you once chased.

Write Your Own Story of Stardom

Within a limited number of years, every week, every job, and every encounter will become part of your unique journey through show business.

Rise from an unknown newcomer to a star shining beneath the spotlight.

How far will your dreams take you?

The answer is in your hands.

During your journey, you will meet actors, singers, idols, directors, writers, and many others working throughout the entertainment industry.

Each person has their own personality, history, ambitions, and private struggles. Some may become close friends or professional rivals. Some may offer support when you need it most, while others may gradually become someone special.

Spend time together through work, invitations, and everyday encounters. Your decisions about ambition, friendship, and romance will shape your relationships and open different stories and possibilities.

Face the Pressure of Fame

Popularity brings more than applause.

As your name becomes more widely known, you will face demanding schedules, public expectations, media attention, professional competition, and growing physical and emotional pressure.

Fatigue and stress can affect your performance, while difficult decisions may cause you to miss valuable opportunities. Learning when to push forward and when to slow down is an important part of building a sustainable career.

There is no single definition of success.

You may become a superstar celebrated for countless performances and awards. You may discover the field you truly love and build a future with the people who matter to you. Or you may realize that the life you want is different from the dream you once chased.

Write Your Own Story of Stardom

Within a limited number of years, every week, every job, and every encounter will become part of your unique journey through show business.

Rise from an unknown newcomer to a star shining beneath the spotlight.

How far will your dreams take you?

The answer is in your hands.
store_data.short_description: Reaching For The Star is a modern entertainment industry life simulation where you play as a rising actress. Plan your weekly schedule, improve your skills, audition for new roles, build relationships, and shape your own journey from an unknown newcomer to a legendary star.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Mihtgast Empire, celebrating peace for the first time in centuries, is thrust back into turmoil with the death of their leader and disappearance of his heir. As the world experiences an alchemical revolution, a new age of war is on the horizon, and the Wyrd, a vast and dangerous wilderness once thought uninhabitable, is trapped in the eye of the storm. Will its people rise to face these new challenges, or will they become a footnote in the annals of history?

Wyrdwic: At the Heart of a New World is a narrative-driven puzzle management game that follows the newest members of the Guardians’ guild, an organisation dedicated to the people of the Wyrd. Surrounded by dangerous creatures of all kinds, it falls to you as the guild’s manager to lead its members as they fight to protect, guide and aid those around you in an ever changing world on the brink of war. 

  • Experience the story of Aefre, rightful heir to the Mihtgastian throne as she leads the Guardians’ guild, making allies, friends and enemies in her fight to reclaim her home.

  • Lead and befriend a wide cast of characters from several unique locales, both from within the Wyrd and beyond its borders.

  • Determine which of your guild members are best suited to the tasks before you, and guide them as they tackle challenges both great and small.

  • Rely on the people of the Wyrd when you need them, just as they do to you.

  • Make decisions that determine the future of the continent at large.

  • Build the future you want to see.

store_data.about_the_game:
John is spending another quiet monthly shift inside ZUCH, an automated flak machine protecting a factory in rural New Zealand. The machine normally identifies and destroys incoming drones without human involvement. John is only there to supervise - until an unusual request forces him to make a decision the system will not forget.

Flak Duty is a short, linear science-fiction visual novel told through illustrated filmstrip-style pages. There are no combat sections, puzzles, or branching choices. Progress through the story at your own pace, move backward and forward between pages, hide the text to view the artwork, and adjust the presentation for comfortable reading.

Features

  • A complete standalone science-fiction story

  • Illustrated filmstrip-style presentation

  • A linear narrative designed to be completed in one sitting

  • Previous and next page navigation

  • Hideable text and adjustable text size

  • Light and dark reading modes

  • Keyboard and mouse support

  • Atmospheric soundtrack

Flak Duty is the third title in the emagnetic Filmstrip Stories series. More stories are on the way.

store_data.about_the_game:
Larithea is a cozy anime RPG about friendship, trust, revenge, and finding

your way back from the darkness. A team of young mages is sent out into the

world — each of them with their own road ahead. Others have walked it before. Few

found their way back.

Meet the team

  • Maya — the heart of the party. A caring healer, the steady hand who holds everyone together.

  • Tara — fast, fierce, and direct. She acts before others have finished thinking, and rarely apologizes for it.

  • Nell — throws himself into every situation with open-eyed enthusiasm, even when the danger is real and closing in fast.

  • Grey — outspoken and razor-sharp. Joins early and quickly becomes the one everyone turns to when things get complicated.

  • Dart — self-contained, careful, harder to read than the others.

Build your spells

Craft your own spells from the materials you gather — combine sigils to make the

attacks and support your team runs on.

Lead the team

Turn-based encounters on a grid. Place your spells, plan your positions, watch

the fight unfold.

The world

Something is off at the edge of the desert. Strange lights, old spells waking up,

water gone from where it always was. Ormron sits at the border of a Veil no one

crosses — and whatever's stirring out there was buried a long time ago, on

purpose.

In this chapter

  • A five-member party, each with their own school of magic

  • Spell crafting from sigils

  • Dozens of turn-based battles across a branching path through the Ormron desert

  • A story told in chapters, released one at a time

store_data.about_the_game:
Last Ascender is a 1st-person turn-based strategy RPG that combines the progression of classic RPGs with the tension of roguelikes and the deep strategy of deckbuilding. In a world shrouded by the Demon King’s darkness, you must end this desperate journey armed only with your unique builds and strategic choices.



Dynamic turn-based combat

Become an 'Ascender' to save the world and dive into the battlefield. With intuitive controls, leave behind the boredom of traditional turn-based combat and experience both strategic depth and the thrill of dynamic action!


Unique class-specific skills

Defeat enemies faster and more satisfyingly by utilizing the unique skills of your characters! With distinct skills for each class, you can experience a completely different style of combat every time. Embark on a new journey and discover your own unique combat strategy with every run.


Craft your own build with relics.

Collect and combine over 100 unique and distinct relics on your journey. Upgrade them to enhance their power, or synthesize them to forge even stronger relics. Make the best choices at every moment to complete your ultimate build!


Diverse enemies that put your strength to the test.

Advance by defeating enemies with diverse abilities. As the difficulty increases, enemies not only grow stronger but also gain new abilities to put you to the test. Devise a more powerful build to overcome the trials posed by these formidable foes.

New characters and events will be continuously added throughout Early Access, alongside ongoing balance updates. The power to enrich this journey lies in your hands! Don't wait—embrace the power of your journey and become the Ascender who saves the world.

The Drawing Spy Game

No words. Just your brush — expose the hidden spy.

A multiplayer party game that reinvents "Spot the Spy" on a shared canvas. Everyone gets a secret word — civilians share the same one, the spy gets a similar one. 🎮 Core Gameplay

🖌️ Stroke-by-Stroke Relay Drawing

No talking — only drawing. On your turn you add a single stroke: clear enough for allies to recognize you, subtle enough not to reveal the word.

🖍️ Relay Painting — Players take turns drawing on one shared canvas

🎨 Free Brush — Multiple colors and sizes, express however you like

🕵️ Hint & Bluff — Civilians drop clues, the spy blends in

⏱️ Real-Time Sync — Every stroke appears instantly on all screens

🗳️ Deduction & Voting

When the round ends, read the canvas and find the odd one out.

🔍 Hover to Trace — Hover any player to highlight the strokes they drew

🖼️ Fullscreen View — Scroll to zoom, drag to pan, inspect every detail

🗳️ Anonymous Voting — Everyone votes; the most-voted player is out

🎭 Identity Reveal — Spies and Mr. White are exposed one by one

Starting from a single egg, your very own Lulu Rabbit moves right onto your desktop. It will sit obediently at the edge of your screen, swinging its long ears, and keep you company through every day.

Together, you can run a little farm—plant crops, water flowers, go fishing. Take your harvest and catch to the market to sell for shell coins. Even as you type or click, Lulu Rabbit helps you save up extra shells on the side. Once you've saved enough shell coins, head to the shop to buy all kinds of pretty outfits and handy tools—puffy skirts, straw hats, hair clips, watering cans... You can dress up Lulu Rabbit in a new look every day.

When you need to focus on work or study, just start the Pomodoro timer, set your work and rest intervals, and let Lulu Rabbit share the same routine as you.

No complicated goals, no stressful pace. Farming, dressing up, and companionship—a simple pastoral life, all starting with one fluffy Lulu Rabbit.

store_data.about_the_game:
Everyone has a price. What's yours?

Football made you famous. The syndicate made you rich. THE FIXER is a narrative career sim where you live both lives at once: the rising star chasing titles on Saturday, and the fixer selling pieces of the match all week long.

ONE WEEK IN THE LIFE OF A FIXER

  • Monday, wake-up. Headlines, rumours, the fallout of what you did.
  • Tuesday, network. Lifestyle, family, contacts: grow the web that protects you.
  • Wednesday, fixing. The syndicate's offers arrive: a provoked yellow card, a missed sitter, a thrown match for a fortune.
  • Thursday, cover-up. Bets and sabotage on one side; laundering fronts and damage control on the other.
  • Friday, prep. Sharpen your legs, or your alibi.
  • Saturday, match. Play it live, minute by minute, or take the express result. Same consequences either way.
  • Sunday, debrief. The week's bill arrives. All of it.

MATCHES YOU CAN BEND

Live text matches with real stakes: tactical calls with visible success odds, fixes to pull off in the moment, a live betting window priced by an honest bookmaker, and momentum that swings with every duel. Pay the referee and the whistle goes quiet: a penalty, a red card for the opposition, and total impunity on the pitch. But the cameras see what the referee will not.

THE WORLD CLOSES IN

Suspicion is a gauge with a number, and at 100 the number wins. Press conferences turn into traps. Investigative journalists build files on you. A nemesis takes it personally. Buried cases reopen, referees burn, trials end careers. Every dirty euro under the mattress is a question you will have to answer one day.

A REAL FOOTBALL CAREER, TOO

Titles, the captain's armband, transfers, awards ceremonies, and a Cup of Nations every four seasons. Dialogue choices resolve with visible dice rolls. You can try to play it clean. The game will tempt you anyway.

BUILD YOUR LEGEND ACROSS LIVES

13 retirement verdicts, 8 ways to lose everything, a Hall of Careers that archives every life, and a legacy system: each finished career unlocks starting perks, backgrounds and mandates for the next one. The world remembers who you were.

Build a legend, or burn it all down.

store_data.about_the_game:
When Heaven Falls Silent, Hell Finds a Voice.

The world of Sanctum Wars is dying.

For centuries, humanity endured beneath the protection of divine light. Then, without warning, the prayers ceased to reach Heaven. The sacred resonance that once bound mankind to God fell silent, leaving the world vulnerable to ancient horrors long imprisoned beneath reality itself.

Now corruption spreads across kingdoms. Faith is fading. Civilization is collapsing. And Hell no longer waits beyond the veil.

You are Thalor, an elite knight of the Ordo Aeternum Lux, dispatched to investigate the once-prosperous city of Valensbrück, where an entire population has vanished beneath an unholy silence.

What begins as a mission to uncover the city's fate soon reveals a conspiracy that threatens not only humanity, but the very order of creation.

Every step deeper into Valensbrück brings you closer to a truth the world was never meant to uncover.

EXPLORE A FALLEN CITY

Journey through the cursed lands of Valensbrück, from abandoned villages and forgotten mines to towering cathedrals, plague-ridden districts, ruined fortresses, and ancient catacombs hidden beneath the city.

Every location tells the story of a civilization consumed by corruption, where every ruin, every corpse, and every forgotten prayer reveals another piece of the world's downfall.

MASTER TACTICAL MELEE COMBAT

Every duel is a test of discipline.

Master deliberate, weighty melee combat inspired by historical martial traditions. Learn weapon-specific movesets, chain precise attacks, manage your stamina, and exploit enemy openings in battles where reckless aggression is punished and every strike matters.

HOLD FAST TO YOUR FAITH

As Heaven grows silent, your faith becomes your greatest weapon.

Discover sacred relics, forgotten prayers, and ancient rites that strengthen your resolve while resisting the corruption spreading throughout the world. Every decision shapes both your journey and the fate of those who still endure.

FACE THE INFERNAL

Confront corrupted humans, twisted abominations, and infernal entities born from humanity's broken connection to the divine.

Each enemy presents unique behaviors, strengths, and tactical challenges that reward observation, patience, and mastery.

A CINEMATIC DARK FANTASY EXPERIENCE

Immerse yourself in a handcrafted medieval world brought to life through cinematic storytelling, richly detailed environments, atmospheric lighting, and an original orchestral soundtrack.

Every ruined chapel, abandoned battlefield, forgotten village, and whispered prayer serves a larger mystery waiting to be uncovered.

FEATURES

  • Explore the first chapter of the Sanctum Wars universe.

  • Experience a dark medieval world inspired by Gothic architecture and historical Europe.

  • Master tactical third-person melee combat built around precision, timing, and weapon mastery.

  • Uncover the mystery behind God's Silence through exploration and environmental storytelling.

  • Face terrifying infernal creatures and unforgettable boss encounters.

  • Discover sacred relics, forgotten prayers, and powerful rites.

  • Traverse handcrafted villages, mines, castles, cathedrals, and underground catacombs.

  • Experience cinematic storytelling powered by next-generation visuals and immersive audio.

- Plot -

In Jeff Quest, you'll follow the story of Jeff, who—due to a failed experiment—has shrunk to the size of an insect. His relationship with Mia is in crisis, and you'll have to try to find her so he can apologize. But many dangers await you, including death scenes if you take the wrong path, and so on—and toward the end, you’ll discover that Mia will love both of you.

- Details -

  • Jeff Quest features death scenes to make his adventure realistic—and even dangerous—as he sets out on his journey to find Mia.

  • The game does not currently include soundtracks, but we will be working on them in future updates.

  • The game doesn't have any RPG elements, but it's a story-driven game with dialogue and even some short cutscenes to make the whole experience as realistic as possible.

  • The goal of the game is to apologize to Mia, but there are dangers along the way.

  • Multiple endings: The game features a bad ending and the canonical happy ending.
